title: Should You Buy Uber Stock Because Its Operating Margin Keeps Climbing?
summary: Uber Technologies (UBER) trades at $73.13, down about 20% over the past twelve months, while the S&P 500 (SPY) returned roughly 19%, and the stock sits at about 72% of its 52-week high. title: RXO reports August truckload gross profit per load increase of more than 10%
summary: RXO (NYSE:RXO) said its truckload gross profit per load increased by more than 10% in August compared with July, exceeding the outlook provided during its second-quarter earnings conference call. The truck brokerage and transportation services company said spot freight accounted for approximately 50% of its full-truckload volume during the first two months of the third quarter.

title: Enterprise Purchasing Group and RXO Launch New Strategic Partnership
summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C., September 03, 2026--RXO (NYSE: RXO), a leading provider of asset-light transportation solutions, today announced it has entered into a preferred partnership with Enterprise Purchasing Group (epg), the world's leading group purchasing organization (GPO) for logistics procurement and supply chain optimization. Through this strategic partnership, RXO becomes epg’s official FTL and LTL provider, and epg stands alone as the only logistics GPO offering RXO’s industry-leading services.
